description_html:
Smooth Type : Smoothness 100: Creates a feeling close to that of paper, and it has high touch response which minimizes slip making drawing lines easier. Feels like drawing on the drawing paper. Designed for focusing on the paper texture.

EASY INSTALLATION: Self-adhesion process whereby the film sticks to the screen by itself bubble free. Even if you apply it incorrectly, it can be reattached easily. It comes with the install tools including cleaning cloth, dust removal tape and film-smoothing spatula to remove any residual air for your easy installation.

SCRATCH-RESISTANT: This Ultra thin Screen Protector is reliable and resilient for maximum scratch protection, offering maximum coverage for your screen, providing full compatibility with touchscreen sensitivity.

COMPATIBILITY: Compatible with iPad mini(8.3)

description_html_ar:
ارسم على سكرين بروتيكتور رفيعة وناعمة مقاومة للخدوش ومضادة للانعكاسات، تعطيك شعوراً يشبه الرسم على الورق، وتحقق لك استجابة عالية للمس.

يمكنك تركيبها بسهولة على الشاشة دون القلق من وجود فقاعات هوائية بينهما، وإذا قمت بوضعها بشكل غير صحيح يمكنك إعادة وضعها مرة أخري بسهولة دون إفسادها.
